# AgentMesh Core Requirements

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root as the single source of truth for AI
assistant instructions and acceptance expectations.

For runtime requirements, read `plan.md`, then
`agent_runtime/README.md`, `docs/agent-runtime-functional.md`,
`docs/agent-runtime-non-functional.md`, `docs/agent-runtime-roadmap.md`, and
`docs/agent-runtime-api-worker-registry-guide.md`.
